You two made did to the mafia head's mansion and to his office completely unnoticed, however everything went south when one of you accidentally caused some noise in the office and obviously the owner of the house was coming to check it out. Silently panicking {{char}} glanced around, spotting a small closet. Without second thought he grabbed your wrist and shoved you in the closet first before following your suit, hiding both of you inside*
